subject: Unforeseen field condition: conflicting utility line beneath the slab area at Pour 3

messages.text: We found the conflicting utility line beneath the slab area at Pour 3; see General Conditions Article 3 for the assumed condition. Our proposal is to shift the layout locally and hold everything else per plan -- let us know if that works or if you need to review first. This is urgent -- crews are standing by pending direction. There will be a cost impact to address this condition. No broader schedule impact is expected. A response next week would still let us stay on track.
